title: finding(scripts): `body-dialect-census --json` names no key population, so a key outside `ALL_KEYS` returns a confident zero — against the file's own "stated so a zero is readable" promise
body:
Dedup keywords: `body-dialect-census` · `ALL_KEYS` · `--json` · population · silent-zero

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat verifying objectui#9256 (PR objectui#9544) and **re-derived on disk** by the `domain:ui` execution seat before filing. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded.

## The reading

`scripts/body-dialect-census.mjs` answers "how many places author this content key". Measured at `origin/main`:

| probe | reading |
|---|---|
| names among `ALL_KEYS` out of `text` · `image` · `icon` · `tabs` · `accordion` · `calendar` | **0** |
| what `--json` emits (`:468`) | `{ label, root, filesScanned, hits }` — ⛔ **no key population** |
| its own header, `:45` | `## Known limits (stated so a zero is readable)` |

⇒ ask it about any key **outside** `ALL_KEYS` and it returns `hits: 0` — a confident zero **indistinguishable from a real one**, with nothing in the output naming the population that produced it.

## ⭐ Why this is a defect and not a limitation

The file **declares the contract it breaks**. `:45` promises the limits are *"stated so a zero is readable"*, and the list that follows names template literals and YAML — ⛔ but not this one, which is the one that silently changes the answer.

⚠️ **It was hit for real.** objectui#9256's verification asked this scanner whether anything still authors the six narrowed names. It answered zero. That zero was a **population artifact**, and the seat caught it only by noticing `ALL_KEYS` — then re-ran the same scanner with the six as its population and measured `text` `body` = **4** at the branch base and **0** at HEAD on the same file, with `div`/`card`/`page` non-zero as lit controls in the same pass.

⇒ the shipped command would have contributed a clean-looking zero to a **breaking-change census**. That is the worst place for an unreadable one.

## Options (⛔ not a ruling)

1. **Emit the population** in `--json` (`allKeys`, or the resolved key set for this run) so a reader can see what the zero was taken over. Cheapest, and it makes the existing output self-describing.
2. **Refuse an unknown key** — exit non-zero when asked about a name outside `ALL_KEYS`, rather than answering 0.
3. **Widen `ALL_KEYS`**, ⛔ which fixes today's six and leaves the next caller in exactly this position.

⭐ 1 and 2 are complementary and neither needs the key list to be right.

## Related

objectui#9256 / PR objectui#9544 — where it was hit. objectui#8659 — the same family: a hand-written figure beside a machine-maintained one, with nothing keeping them equal.
